audit_limits: Original-byte checking covers every selected member, not excluded binaries, tools, build trees, third-party header bodies, or all dependencies named by records.
Excluded directory entries are pruning roots; their descendants are not inventoried.

Embedded binding checks cover recognized path/hash pairs that resolve to selected members; external and deliberately excluded references are counted separately. Explicit live_file_snapshot_only observations retain their historical digest and are listed separately instead of being asserted to identify the finished file.
Private-key and signed-URL scans are bounded pattern checks, not a complete secret or redistribution-rights audit.
A completed-report marker does not certify result correctness or acceptance.
Digest consistency checks integrity against this inventory; no signature or origin authentication is established by the exporter.
Planning is a point-in-time observation. Re-run after all execution and review writers stop; build re-reads every selected input before publication.
Deterministic bytes require identical inputs, selection, helper and Python/zlib compression implementation; gzip timestamps and filenames are fixed.
digest_policy: original_sha256 and original_size_bytes identify the exact retained input bytes. published_sha256 and published_size_bytes identify content.encode('utf-8') after literal path-prefix substitution only. Every pre-existing digest or size inside embedded records still describes ORIGINAL bytes and is never recomputed or rewritten. Verify published members with their published fields; verifying original fields requires the retained originals. An unchanged member has equal original and published bytes, sizes, and hashes.

workspace parent, when source and work are siblings

scope: Text evidence packaging only. Completed execution packets, historical failures, logs and reviews retain their individual scope. This export grants no acceptance and makes no execution, numerical, hardware, or phase-completion decision.
